evals.name: route-design-request-to-pipeline
evals.prompt: I want to design a landing page for a new open-source CI/CD tool called 'PipeKit'. It should have a hero section, feature highlights, a code example block, pricing cards, and a footer. What's your plan? Don't build anything yet — just tell me the steps.

assertions.text: First step is picking a style using the design-md-style-picker skill
Second step is applying the style using design-md-style-apply
Third step is auditing with design-md-style-audit
Does not produce UI code or a full landing page — only outlines the pipeline steps
References the DESIGN.md catalog or voltagent/awesome-design-md as the style source

evals.name: route-style-question-to-picker
evals.prompt: What style fits my project? I'm building a collaborative whiteboard app for designers — infinite canvas, drag-and-drop, real-time cursors, minimal chrome. It should feel creative and playful but stay precise for detailed work. No dark-mode-only tools — light theme with a warm feel. What DESIGN.md aesthetic should I use?

assertions.text: Routes to the design-md-style-picker sub-skill instead of answering directly
Checks for an existing TASTE.md before making style recommendation
Does not enter the apply or audit phases — stops at style selection since the user only asked what style fits
Selected style matches the creative/infinite-canvas product category, not a dev-tool or trading density source
